STUDY 135
Black Lace Top & Blue Sky
Rights check
Source: 25021.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark hair blowing
slightly across her shoulder stands outdoors against a
bright blue sky. She wears a black high-neck
long-sleeve lace top with a ruffled hem and a silver
chain necklace. Dark cargo trousers and a black strap
complete the look. Her expression is calm and serious,
with a direct gaze. Warm, natural sunlight with a soft
blurred background. Palette of black, sky blue, and
warm skin tones. Candid and grunge-inspired, in the
style of a film photo.
Candid, grunge-inspired, moody
WORKING NOTES
- The lace top and blue sky are the strongest contrast.
- Keep the blurred background for a candid film feel.
